thor-pedersen.about:
Why should I get certified?

Getting certified is a smart career move that can open doors to high-paying jobs and career advancement, they can help you stand out in a competitive market and achieve your career goals.

With our on-demand courses, you can get certified on your schedule, making it easier to balance your studies with your busy life.

There are over 760,000 open jobs in Cyber Security in the US.
In 2020 and 2021 alone, 263,000 new professionals joined the cybersecurity workforce, even with that, the job openings still increased by 17,000.

Here are some compelling reasons to get certified:

  •  CISSP: Average salary: $125,000/year; 140,000 open jobs in the US.

  •  CISM: Average salary: $137,000/year; 58,000 open jobs in the US.

  •  CC: Average salary: $119,000/year; 760,000 open jobs in cybersecurity in the US.

  •  PMP: Average salary: $120,000/year; 200,000 open jobs in the US.



Why should I use your courses for my certification studying?

Passing your certifications requires the right approach and materials, in my courses you get both.

With over 670,000 enrollments from 200+ countries, my CISSP, CC, and CISM courses are not only "Best Selling" but also the "Highest Rated" on Udemy.

Join a community of successful students who have transformed their careers with my proven methods.



Who are you, Thor?

Hi, I’m Thor Pedersen, a seasoned IT, Cyber Security, and Project Management instructor teaching the CISSP, CISM, CC, and PMP certifications.

My journey began in 1987 with a Commodore 64, turning a hobby into a rewarding career in cybersecurity, networking, data centers, and project management.

My extensive experience and dedication to teaching helps thousands of students pass their certification exams every year.



Student Testimonials

I think my courses are fantastic, but don't just take my word for it. Here's what some of my students have to say:

"Thor's videos played a major factor in my ability to pass. I cannot recommend them enough." (Blair, 5-stars)

How should I start my certification studying?

1. Find the materials you need:

  •  CISSP: 1-2 good video courses, 1-2 good books, 2,500-3,500 Easy/Mid questions, and 1,000-1,500 Hard/Complex questions.

  •  CISM: 1 good video course, the CISM AIO book, and the ISACA CISM QAE questions.

  •  PMP: 1 good video course, Rita’s PMP book, the PMBOK, and 1,000-2,000 practice questions.

  •  CC: 1 good video course and 400-1,700+ practice questions.

2. Build a study plan and commit to it.

3. Learn to deconstruct questions and find the keywords and indicators.

4. Manage your time during the exam.

For more detailed guidance, take a look at my free ThorTeaches "CISSP: How to Study" course.





Let me help YOU get certified. Take the first step towards advancing your career with my comprehensive, highly-rated courses.

Thor Pedersen

Build the knowledge behind confident security decisions.

At Cyvitrix Learning, we help learners develop their understanding of cybersecurity, IT auditing, governance, risk and compliance. Our aim is to connect certification study with the reasoning and professional judgment needed in the workplace.

Our catalog serves learners at different stages: people building their first IT and security foundations, professionals preparing for certifications, and practitioners developing their auditing, risk management and leadership knowledge.

Our teaching philosophy starts with three questions: What does this concept mean? Why does it matter? How would you use it when making a decision? We want learners to understand relationships between topics, recognize trade-offs and explain their reasoning with confidence.

Learning also involves asking questions. Through Udemy’s course Q&A, we welcome requests for clarification, alternative perspectives and constructive feedback. A lecture title, timestamp or specific example helps us understand your concern and provide a useful response. Your feedback also helps us prioritize improvements.

We use technology to support course production and multilingual delivery, including text-to-speech narration in many courses. Please explore the preview lessons and curriculum to find the level, format and teaching style that suit you. We believe professional growth should be accessible to people with different backgrounds, budgets and starting points. Bring your curiosity, ask thoughtful questions and keep building your skills with us.

The Cyvitrix Learning Team
